'''Greg Heisler Harvest 99''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Greg Heisler]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-1384">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/1384 Harvest 99], DeckTech (Greg "rabidjedi" Heisler, 24 November 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/1384/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/1384/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018222227/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/1384/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Greg Heisler]]
* '''Published:''' 24 November 1999 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Harvest 99''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut|Premiere-L-tatooineobiwanshut.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor OWHut Heisler LS 1999 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck is meant to regenerate as much as possible and lay the smack-down all all opposition

== Original post ==

'''Harvest 99'''
* '''Author:''' Greg "rabidjedi" Heisler
* '''Published:''' November 24, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' This deck is meant to regenerate as much as possible and lay the smack-down all all opposition

=== Strategy ===

The setup is to start with Lar's Moisture Farm and Obi-wan's Hut.  then, deploy to the farm and get a stable drain and force to backup Owen and Beru.  then, you can beat up others and still retrieve your lost pile.	That's it

Have Fun
